intro: Guard Thomas waits at the eastern bridge between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp. The fate of his missing men may show whether the river murlocs threaten more than scouts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have confirmed my fears, friend. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
